title.es: El de cuando Fina se planta
title.en: The One Where Fina Stands Her Ground

description.es: Tras los últimos acontecimientos con Marta, Fina le planta cara y se defiende. Le dice que nunca será una persona distinta de quien es, que Marta puede despedirla por ello si quiere, pero que no merece el trato que le ha dado. El aroma de un perfume hace que Marta tenga una ensoñación con Fina. Se disculpa con ella y le dice que quiere que vuelva a su puesto de dependienta.
description.en: After the recent events with Marta, Fina stands up to her and defends herself. She declares that she will never be anyone other than who she is, that Marta can fire her for it if she wants, but that she does not deserve the way Marta has treated her. Marta daydreams about Fina through the scent of the perfume. She apologizes to Fina and tells her she wants her to return to her position as a shop assistant.
